book.name: Umatta
book.title: Isarhe Iyiki Ize iyi Umatta aka atsɛng

content: Unyaka arherhe aki irhowu ipfuna
Uyesu abvui arherhuwe umbɔ unyaka arherhe agɛ,
<<Iyɛrhe afã iwu ru nyaku uyɛrhe uwɔɔ aka akorhuwe irhowa ipfuna ru ungwɛ̃nga.
Adene agãrhãnga azĩ ayisuwe abirabɛ umbɔ aka aghwi umbɔ ipfuna hã aba, bɔr umbɔ akpɛ̃mbɔ ibibanga.

<<Mɔcɛ unga abvui adene agãrhã abika arhɛɛ agɛ, <Àka adɛyiwe abirabɛ umbɔ aka aghwi ugɛ umum iki ikorhumum ubinghaa. Iki ingwã ínak iyiki itsak nggu angwɛ̃ inak aka agɔnga, abina kishoo iki igbisha imaamum. Àka aba irhowa ha!>
<<Bɔr umbɔ asi inyãmbɔ ngge iwengge ifɛrhɛ, na azĩmbɔ. Uwɔɔ azĩã usinga, uwɔɔ azĩã igoyi igoi ri izɛɛ.
Abɔɔ adzur agãrhãnga, ayɔm na afɛre umbɔ.
Uyɛrhe ha agũ avɔm. Unga adene abi iwanga, umbɔ afɛrkumbɔ umbɔ abika afɛyi aner ha na akpĩĩwe uteumbɔ kishoo.
<<Mɔcɛ unga agɔr agãrhãnga agɛ, <Aka amaambɔ izek irhowa ha, bɔr abirabɛ umum iki ighwi isi imɛ̃ngge umbɔ aba.
Àka adzek adɔsa atsĩndĩ aka agbopa ayisa kishoo abirabɛ umbi aka akpo, umbɔ aba irhowa ha.>
Nggee agãrhã hã adzek adɔsa atsĩndĩã ayisa kishoo abirabɛ umbɔ aka akpo, abika aze nu abika abewe, anang irhowa ha atɔk nggu atsen.
<<Bɔr ivangyɛ uyɛrhe aka atsĩ abee inyã abi irhowa ha, umɔ unga anyã uner uwɔɔ aka asi itsima atorho irhowa.
Uyɛrhe arhusu uner ha agɛ, <A uwee, ungo ukorhu uguse nu utsĩwã nggimi ushiɔ ra atorho irhowa?> Bɔr uner ha asi idzipunga urhɛm.
<<Mɔcɛ uyɛrhe agɔr abi itsernga agɛ, <Àka abow aboknga nu adaknga, na atare unga adzek atsĩ ru uzĩ, anangkɛ anera aka iciu akpe na atãi anyĩ.>
<<Ubinkutsu awuri ighwi anera arhɛrhɛ, bɔr ukunjiir umbɔ aka isɛng.>>
Irhusu ifai ikirbi abĩ ru Ukaisar
Mɔcɛ abi Ufarisi adzek akɛki itsũwãyɛ umbɔ aka ideya unga ru irhɛmnga.

Umbɔ adene angwɛ̃ imesambɔ nggu aner Uhiridu agɛ, <<A umarhem, umɛn ihwɛngmɛn ungo uwu uner idzidzɛrhe, ikɛi ungo uni imesuwe ubinkpi Unum aka abee nggu idzidzɛrhe. Ubinkutsu ungo usi itsukɔ amɛnngo ri ifɛrhkɔ anera use ubinkpi umbɔ aka awe.
Udɛyiwa umɛn, imɛ̃ngge umɛn ifai ikirbi abĩ ru Ukaisar, use isi imɛ̃ngge?>>
Bɔr Uyesu ahwɛnga ifɛrhkɔ iyiki ibewambɔ, unga agɔr umbɔ agɛ, <<Umbi abi ukpukpeta, awu use utsu umbi adeya umum?
Àka adɛyiwa umum ishaa imangyɛ umbi iki ikũ afai ikirbi abĩ.>> Umbɔ akowe unga ishaa imang hã,
unga arhusa umbɔ agɛ, <<Uzirhzĩ ukpi nu itsok ikɛrɛ iwu iki ungaa?>>
Umbɔ agɛ, <<Iki Ukaisar.>> Mɔcɛ unga agɔr umbɔ agɛ, <<Àka adzowe Ukaisar abinkɛ aka awe aki Ukaisar, ikɛi àka adzowe Unum abinkɛ aka awe aki Unum.>>
Umbɔ aka agũ rimi, umbɔ adzeidzeu. Nggee umbɔ abɔre unga na azĩmbɔ.
Irhusa isisok ra akpe
Ru unum hã abi Usaduki, abika agɔr ugɛ isok ra akpe ishingge, aba ru unga arhusa agɛ,
<<A umarhem, Umusa agɔr agɛ, <Unera aba akpe na ashia ra awɛkaci, awu ufang ungwɛ̃mbɔ apfunu utsɛrh ha amare awɛkaci ru unga.>
Umɔ abɔɔ rabɔ awu angwɛ̃yi utɔɔva ru umɛn. Uwu inggbaashia apfuna na akpea, asi imara awɛkaci, abɔruka utsɛrh ha ru ungwɛ̃mbɔ.
Rimi hã iki iwe nggu ungwɛ̃mbɔ uwu uvaa nu uwu untaar, uzĩ itsĩ ru uwu utɔɔva.
Ri imimasha utsɛrh ha akpea.
Ru unumkpi abika akpe aka isok ra akpe, utsɛrh ha awuri iwu uwu ungaa ru umbɔ utɔɔva ha? Ubinkutsu, kishookambɔ utɔɔva aka apfuna unga.>>
Uyesu agɔr umbɔ agɛ, <<Umbi agba irhak, ubinkutsu, umbi asi ihwɛngmbi itsɛng Arherhu-Num use ijee Unum.
Ri isok ra akpe anera asi ípfunumbɔ, asi ídzowukumbɔ ipfuna. Anera awuri iwe ru nyaka ípfu itser-Num ra afã.
Bɔr arherhi isisok abika akpukpe, umbi anasi ivarhumbi ubinkpi Unum aka adɛyiwa umbi?
Unga agɔr agɛ, <Umum iwu Unum uwu Uibrahim, Unum uwu Uishaku, nu Unum uwu Uyakubu.>
Unga asi iwea Unum uwu abika akpukpe bɔr awu Unum uwu abi urhɛ.>>
Ivangyɛ ikikɔnga iki igũ rimi, umbɔ adzeidzeu imesanga.
Ikpem iyiki igɔnga
Abi Ufarisi aka agũ ugɛ Uyesu aka atsu abi Usaduki awu uku uvep, umbɔ akɔng.
Unying ru umbɔ uwuku uhwɛng Ikpem akarhãrhã, avira arhusa unga agɛ,
<<A umarhem, ikpem iyikisong iwu iyiki igɔnga ri Íkpem Umusa?>>
Uyesu agɔr unga agɛ, << <Ubemu Uteijee Unumngo nggu amɛnngo kishoo nu ipfungo kishoo nu adzɛnngo kishoo.>
Ikpem iyɛrɛ ngge iwu iyi inggbaashia nu iyiki igɔnga.
Nu iyi uvaa iwu ru nyaki iyi unggbaashi ha igɛ, <Ubemu undɔkango ru nyaki itsikamngo.>
Kishoo Íkpem Umusa nu imesa abika asɔm Arherhu-Num iyurhi nú atsi íkpem iyɛrɛ ikivarhangge.>>
Ukiristo awu ungwɛ̃ ungaa?
Ivangyɛ abi Ufarisi aka akɔng ananga unying, Uyesu arhusa umbɔ agɛ,
<<Ifɛrhkɔ umbi iwu use ri itsi Ukiristo? Unga awu ungwɛ̃ ungamɔ?>> Umbɔ agɛ, <<Ungwɛ̃ Udauda.>>
Unga agɔr umbɔ agɛ, <<Awu use utsu Udauda ri ijee Ipfu-Num ayisa unga agɛ, <Uteijee>? Ubinkutsu, unga agɛ,
Udauda aba ayisu Ukiristo agɛ, <Uteijee,> awu use utsu Ukiristo awu ungwɛ̃nga?>>
Unera asi idɛ̃ɛ̃ adzipuka unga urhɛm. Udzur ru unum hã, asi ikpombɔ unera aka abvui arhusa unga arherhe.
